knowledge_point.title: Solving for a Vector in a Linear Combination

question.:question/problem:
Find the value of ${x}_{3}-{x}_{2}$ given that  $6a-2x=b$ and

$$
a=\begin{bmatrix}8 \\ -4 \\ 12 \\ 16\end{bmatrix},\,x=\begin{bmatrix}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3} \\ {x}_{4}\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}16 \\ -12 \\ -24 \\ -20\end{bmatrix}.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}6a-2x & =b \\ -2x & =b-6a \\ x & =-\frac{1}{2}(b-6a) \\ x & =-\frac{1}{2}(\begin{bmatrix}16 \\ -12 \\ -24 \\ -20\end{bmatrix}-6\begin{bmatrix}8 \\ -4 \\ 12 \\ 16\end{bmatrix}) \\ x & =-\frac{1}{2}\begin{bmatrix}-32 \\ 12 \\ -96 \\ -116\end{bmatrix} \\ x & =\begin{bmatrix}16 \\ -6 \\ 48 \\ 58\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${x}_{3}-{x}_{2}=48-(-6)=54.$
